items.title: Pay private doctor's invoice
items.quote: Bitte begleichen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum unter Angabe der Rechnungsnummer.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 26.06.2026. The 30-day period runs from the day after the triggering event per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, so counting starts 27.06.2026. A period of 30 days ending with the expiry of the day which by its number corresponds to the starting day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) ends on 26.07.2026. Checking the calendar, 26.07.2026 falls on a Sunday. Under § 193 BGB, if the last day of a period is a Sunday, holiday, or Saturday, it is replaced by the next business day. Monday 27.07.2026 is not a public holiday in either Hamburg (sender) or Nordrhein-Westfalen, so the due date shifts to 27.07.2026.

warnings: The payment due date (27.07.2026) has already passed as of today's date (01.10.2026); the recipient should check whether this invoice has already been paid or submitted to their private health insurer to avoid a dunning notice.

The invoice is addressed to the patient at a Hamburg address, not Nordrhein-Westfalen; if the patient's actual residence is NRW, double-check which Land's public holidays would govern any deadline computed from a delivery date (not relevant here since the deadline runs from the invoice date, but worth noting).
